def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the first name in names readable inside the directory notes, or "" when none is.

    Runs with fs confined to notes via fs.sub, so absolute paths, .. and
    symlinks cannot reach files outside it. Subdirectory names such as
    sub/b.txt are allowed. A missing or unreadable file counts as not readable.
    """
    post names.len() > 0 or out == ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        for name in names:
            if can_read(name):
                return fs.read(name) else ""
    return ""

def can_read(name: str) -> bool uses fs:
    """True when name can be read with the current fs."""
    _ = fs.read(name) else return False
    return True
